info.name: User and Access Management Groups API
Returns a list of users associated with a group.

params.name: key
params.description: The group's key.

params.name: userKey
params.description: The user's key. Mutually exclusive with `userKeys`.

params.name: userKeys
params.description: Only returns the users matching any of the specified keys. Comma-separated list of user keys. Mutually exclusive with `userKey`.

params.name: nameOrEmailContains
params.description:
Filters users by name or email address. Parameter value must be URL-encoded (percent-encoding) to ensure it's correctly interpreted by the server. Example: Searching for an email with a +
            
 Incorrect: .../users?email=`john+doe@example.com`.
            
 Correct: .../users?email=`john%2Bdoe@example.com`

params.name: nameOrEmailOrUsernameContains
params.description:
Filters users by name or email or username. Parameter value must be URL-encoded (percent-encoding) to ensure it's correctly interpreted by the server. Example: Searching for an email with a +
            
 Incorrect: .../users?email=`john+doe@example.com`.
            
 Correct: .../users?email=`john%2Bdoe@example.com`

params.name: lastLoginAtSince
params.description: Only returns users whose last login occurred on or after the specified date and time.

params.name: lastLoginAtTo
params.description: Only returns users whose last login occurred before or on the specified date and time.

params.name: membershipType
params.description: Filters users by membership type that can be `Assigned` or `Mapped`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results returned. Allowed values: 1 to 100 Default value: 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the first result returned. Default value: 0.

params.name: sort
params.description: Used for sorting the list. Ascending by default. Prepend a hyphen, "-", to get a descending sort, for example "-name". Default: name. Allowed: key, name, email, status, lastLoginAt.

params.name: embed
params.description: List of fields to embed in the response.

items.docs:
Returns a list of users associated with a group that match the specified filters. Use query parameters to refine the search.

API Client needs the **User management > Manage end-user groups** permission.

info.name: Allow to add or remove users from a group.

params.name: key
params.description: The group key.

items.docs:
Allows adding or removing users from a specified group. Manage group membership by specifying the group key and providing lists of user keys to be added or removed.

API Client needs the **User management > Manage end-user groups** permission.

info.name: Returns the list of groups based on specified conditions.

params.name: nameContains
params.description: Filters users by name.

params.name: environmentKey
params.description: Only returns groups associated with the specified environment (stage). Mutually exclusive with `environmentKeys`.

params.name: environmentKeys
params.description: Only returns groups associated with any of the specified environments (stages). Comma-separated list of environment keys. Mutually exclusive with `environmentKey`.

params.name: identityProviderKey
params.description: Only returns groups with claim mappings for the specified identity provider.

params.name: portfolioKeys
params.description: Only returns groups in environments belonging to any of the specified portfolios.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results returned. Allowed values: 1 to 100 Default value: 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the first result returned. Default value: 0.

items.docs:
Returns a list of groups that match the specified filters. Use query parameters to refine the search.

API Client needs the **User management > Manage end-user groups** permission.

Creates a new group by specifying a name and environment (stage). Optionally, you can include a list of users and application roles to assign to the group during creation.

API Client needs the **User management > Manage end-user groups** permission.

params.name: key
params.description: Group key.

items.docs:
Retrieves detailed information about a group, including its name, description, and environment.

API Client needs the **User management > Manage end-user groups** permission.

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the group to be updated.

items.docs:
Updates the details of a group using the group's key. Allows modification of the group's name or description.

API Client needs the **User management > Manage end-user groups** permission.

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the group to be deleted.

items.docs:
Deletes a specified group using the group's key.

API Client needs the **User management > Manage end-user groups** permission.

info.name: Returns a list of application roles associated with a group.

params.name: key
params.description: The group key.

params.name: assetKey
params.description: The asset key.

params.name: applicationRoleKey
params.description: The application role key. Mutually exclusive with `applicationRoleKeys`.

params.name: applicationRoleKeys
params.description: Only returns the application roles matching any of the specified keys. Comma-separated list of application role keys. Mutually exclusive with `applicationRoleKey`.

params.name: nameContains
params.description: Filters application roles by name.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results returned. Allowed values: 1 to 100 Default value: 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the first result returned. Default value: 0.

params.name: sort
params.description: Used for sorting the list. Ascending by default. Prepend a hyphen, "-", to get a descending sort, for example "-name". Default: name. Allowed: name, assetkey.

items.docs:
Returns a list of application roles that match the specified filters. Use query parameters to refine the search.

API Client needs the **User management > Manage end-user groups** permission.

info.name: Allow to add or remove application roles from a group.

params.name: key
params.description: The group key.

items.docs:
Allows adding or removing application roles from a specified group. Manage roles by specifying the group key and providing lists of application role keys to be added or removed.

API Client needs the **User management > Manage end-user groups** permission.

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the Group for the Idp Mapping object to delete.

params.name: mappingKey
params.description: Claim Mapping key.

items.docs:
Delete a specified Group Idp Mapping object using its key.

API Client needs the **User management > Manage end-user groups** permission.
